_: Settings > Network relay switch on a phone (iOS Simulator or Android emulator).
The new relay is a name that never resolves (RFC 2606 .invalid), so the
switch is real but nothing ever connects anywhere else: no fleet peer may
reach the production relay. The relay guard refuses it unless the run names
iOS cannot quit itself: the switch saves the relay for the next launch, the
button stops loading and a note says to close Hollow ('Switch relay'; the
old build said 'Switch and close' and spun forever). Android closes
('Switch and close'); the harness reopens it and the log says which relay
the node dials. One of the two switch taps misses by design (soft).
run (on the Mac mini): pwsh scripts/fleet.ps1 -Scenario relay_switch_mobile -Peers g -RelayAlso switchtest.invalid

steps.target: text:Friends and servers on another relay can't be reached from here.
